# Draft:Vice President and Prime Minister of the United Arab Emirates

The Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE is currently held by Incumbent politician Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum since January 2006.
He is also the current vice president, serving with Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan. Mohammed is the leader of UAE, and oversees all government laws and other forms of government duties. He has been in office since 2006 and also serves as Ruler of Dubai.
